deck_title: Hagen-Poiseuille Q = (pi*Delta_p / 8*mu*L)*R^4 quartic pipe conductance law vs naive R^2 area-only plug-flow rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Gotthilf Hagen (1839) & Jean Léonard Marie Poiseuille (1840) viscous laminar pipe flow quartic conductance law (integrating the parabolic velocity profile v_z(r) = (Delta_p / 4*mu*L)*(R^2 - r^2) across 2*pi*r dr so mean speed scales as R^2 and total volumetric flow scales as Q_HP = (pi*Delta_p / 8*mu*L)*R^4 = Q_0*(1 + u)^2, locking Q_exact / Q_model = 1.0000x across all 17 vessel-dilation stations u = (R/R_0)^2 - 1 in [0.000, 1.000] with 0/17 violated) versus naive area-proportional R^2 plug-flow shader (Q = Q_0*(R/R_0)^2 = Q_0*(1 + u), which underestimates true Poiseuille flow by (R/R_0)^2 = 1 + u to 1.2500x at S4, 1.5000x at S8, and 2.0000x at S16 across 16/17 stations) and 64-ring parabolic velocity quadrature.
